cohort: 152 neonates with clinical sepsis admitted to Dodoma Regional Referral Hospital between January and June 2020
finding: The prevalence of UTI among neonates with clinical sepsis was 18.4%, with Klebsiella pneumoniae and Enterobacter spp. being the most common uropathogens, and ciprofloxacin, nitrofurantoin, and amikacin showing good sensitivity against the isolated bacteria.
gest_age: Neonatal period (specific gestational age not mentioned)
